scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.copy:daemon: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/main', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/main/gsmtc-daemon.ps1', 'dist/main/gsmtc-daemon.ps1'); if (fs.existsSync('src/main/gsmtc-cmd.ps1')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/gsmtc-cmd.ps1', 'dist/main/gsmtc-cmd.ps1'); if (fs.existsSync('src/main/media_keys.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/media_keys.exe', 'dist/main/media_keys.exe'); if (fs.existsSync('public/logo.png')) fs.copyFileSync('public/logo.png', 'dist/main/logo.png');"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "npm run dev:electron"
